sourceText: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu imewekwa kisheria kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.
referenceText: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
